newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products close mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products close mostly higher.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed mostly higher with soymeal particularily strong on commercial bull spreading, traders said.
Support in soymeal also came from rumors Ukraine or China was seeking U.S. soymeal, they said.
Gains in soybeans underpinned the soy product futures market, the traders said.
Soyoil closed 0.03 cent per lb lower to 0.10 higher, with October down 0.03 at 24.91. Soymeal was $3.20 per ton higher to $0.30 lower, with October up $3.20 at $263.20.

Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 14,500 contracts, down from 18,277 Tuesday, according to the CBOT. Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 21,000 contracts, slightly below the 21,353 contracts traded Tuesday.
